text:
maria: quick sec ping — opened PR to tighten the k8s ServiceAccount for the onprem runtime agent: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4591
Summary: removed cluster-admin, add narrow secrets access (get/list) in runtime namespace, add bound-service-account token audience and annotation to limit token use. Need a quick security review for secrets surface and any VPC/on-prem implications. cc @aj @sara

aj: on it. can you paste the RBAC yaml + the projected token annotations you added? also named secrets or patterns?

maria: pasted below — this is the essential part we added:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: runtime-agent-secrets-reader
  namespace: redwood-onprem-runtime
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","list"]
```
and the SA annotation: `kubernetes.io/audiences: ["runtime-agent.redwood.io"]`
We intentionally removed `watch` and cluster-wide verbs. We still read a small set of secrets by name elsewhere in code (mounted by env).

aj: ok couple notes: 1) if it's only specific secret names, prefer `resourceNames: ["runtime-key"]` on the rule instead of wildcard secrets 2) add an audit annotation so accesses surface in logs (e.g., `redwood.com/audit: true`) 3) confirm no change to KMS/HSM flow — the agent still fetches from vault via existing service account token exchange? if yes, we should check vault path permissions are unchanged. Also can you run `go test ./pkg/agent -run TestSecretAccess` locally to validate?

devops-joe: if this is ready I can slot the merge into tonight's maintenance window (22:00 PT). small helper if you want to annotate the SA post-merge: `kubectl annotate sa runtime-agent -n redwood-onprem-runtime redwood.com/audit=true`

sara: product ok with this change, reduces blast radius. @aj do you need anything else to +1? if not, merge after CI + sec-bot. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: static-scan: no hardcoded secrets detected. policy-scan: flagged wildcard on `secrets` if resourceNames not set — recommended change: use `resourceNames` where possible. full report: https://scans.redwood.internal/4591

aj: small nit — if you don't need `list` either, remove it. otherwise looks good. once resourceNames/audit annotation added and CI passes, I'm good to approve. :+1:

maria: thanks — will update PR in ~15m to add resourceNames for the two runtime secrets, add audit annotation, run tests and push. will ping back here when green.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (build, unit, integration, e2e).

maria: merging after minor update and a quick rebase. thanks all! :rocket:
